preparation.scope: one experimentally constrained preparation; other legs are structural extrapolations

coordinate.definition: angle between femur and tibia; decreasing angle is flexion
coordinate.evidence: Mamiya et al. 2018 used 18-180 degree controlled motion and reports approximately 90 degrees at rest and 40-120 degrees during straight walking; the walking observation was unpublished in that article.

motorEvidence.slowRise: did not reach peak within 500 ms
motorEvidence.slowRelease: approximately 100 ms to maximal hyperpolarization effect

sensoryEvidence.claw: tonic position code; flexion- and extension-tuned populations on opposite sides of about 90 degrees, with cell-specific angular tuning and hysteresis
sensoryEvidence.hook: phasic direction code; flexion and extension classes exist
sensoryEvidence.club: phasic bidirectional movement and low-amplitude vibration code; population velocity response peaked near 400 degrees/s

engineeringParameters.disclosure: Normalized recruitment thresholds, extensor transfer, fatigue, passive mechanics and receptor filter constants are engineering choices. Version 3.6 corrects the claw history state so it persists through experimental holds, and constrains hook saturation and club angle modulation by reported qualitative response shapes; their magnitudes are not raw-trace fits.

runtimeBoundary.clubVibration: The body loop cannot resolve the measured 100-2000 Hz club band. It carries a bounded movement/impact envelope to source-identified club roots and never claims to synthesize the vibration waveform or tonotopic frequency map.
runtimeBoundary.motorTransmitter: BANC predicted CNS fast-transmitter calls are preserved for graph signs. Muscle action sign comes from experimentally/annotation-supported effector identity; predicted GABA is not interpreted as direct inhibition of the annotated leg muscle.

heldOut: triangular neural drive not used to choose thresholds
failureCriteria: fast activates under steady drive below 0.70
fast activates while intermediate command is below 0.42
zero neural evidence creates nonzero active force
hook flexion and extension outputs have the same sign
claw flexion response rises with extension or vice versa
